name: 9g Micro Position Servo Motor
description: Like a robotic elbow! Rotates to exact angular positions from 0 to 180 degrees using PWM pulses.
realWorldAnalogy: Like a robotic elbow! Rotates to exact angular positions from 0 to 180 degrees using PWM pulses.
wiringGuidance: Connect Brown wire (Dark Slate) to GND, Red wire (Red) to 5V, and Orange wire (Green) to digital pin 9.
commonMistakes: Manually forcing the horn past 0 or 180 degrees, stripping the small plastic gears.
Powering several servos directly from Arduino 5V regulator, triggering brownout resets.

miniExperiment.title: Servo Arm Sweep
miniExperiment.circuit: Brown to GND, Red to 5V, Orange to Pin 9.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: The servo arm smoothly steps between 0, 90, and 180 degrees every second.
